description: Reviewer major issue 5. One workload held for increasing durations, each from a drained start. Answers whether a short-phase mean is transportable to a long phase. 32 MB/s is just below the measured apply knee (~38 MB/s) so the backlog stays bounded and the comparison is about steady state rather than runaway growth - at an above-capacity rate the 30-minute level would accumulate several gigabytes and the answer would be trivial.
